acceptance_criteria: Each deferred numerical panel maps exactly once to a strict circuit, fault, decoder, observable, and sampling schema.
Complete external contracts run through case-local binary circuit Monte Carlo and distance-aware ZNE handlers.
Missing publication inputs emit blocked_on_paper_input artifacts; no schedule, decoder, shot count, seed, author array, or pixel is guessed.
Implementation attestation cannot increase scientific coverage, paper-exact status, pixel acceptance, or independent-review status.
